description: Run a scheduled agent ONLY when there is something new, instead of purely by the clock. When the agent is due, the server first counts matching rows (cheap SQL); with no hit the run is skipped and costs nothing. Combine with a short cadence (e.g. every 5 minutes) for near event-driven behaviour. Each check: source (see get_agent_condition), plus within_minutes (hits in the last N minutes) OR since_last_run=true. match 'any' (default) or 'all'. Pass remove=true to drop the condition. preset 'takt_scharf' (instead of checks) = wake only on this agent's own new/changed open todos, handoffs to it not yet picked up, new/changed OPEN Pipedrive deals, new lab results and changed asbestos (IK) projects since the last run — the recommended condition for hourly agents. Owner of the agent or tenant admin only.

checks.description: Conditions that must find new rows before the agent runs

since_last_run.description: Count hits since the agent's last run

source.description: Data source and event to count, e.g. new emails or changed leads

within_minutes.description: Count hits from the last N minutes

match.description: any: one check must hit (default); all: every check must hit

preset.description: Predefined condition instead of checks; recommended for hourly agents

name: set_agent_condition
